approvalInterpretation.explanation: Cloudflare DO class lifecycle creation requires Worker deployment; version upload alone cannot create the class. The approved resource-only operation cannot be performed independently.

proposedBindingOnlyAfterSeparateApproval.note: A cross-worker binding avoids coupling DO lifecycle migrations to the current widget Worker. Its future deployment is a separate approval gate.

localWorkerdQa.distinction: Runs locally in Cloudflare workerd runtime but does not prove hosted Cloudflare operation.

rollback.existingWidgetWorker: No change made, so there is no immediate rollback necessary.
rollback.futureIsolatedWorker: DO class lifecycle cannot be rolled back to a version before migration; disable its routes/bindings and leave storage intact until separately approved cleanup.
rollback.deletion: NEVER delete Durable Object data without separate owner consent.

note: The NOT_CREATED and blocked statuses in this file document the earlier B4 checkpoint before the B5 isolated Worker owner deployment, NOT current hosted state. Use the B5 evidence file for current status.
